products.name: Motor Fuel Distribution
products.description: Distribution of branded and unbranded motor fuels (gasoline, diesel, etc.) to dealers, distributors, commission agents, commercial businesses, and company-operated retail sites. Involves large-scale procurement from refiners, storage, blending, and delivery via pipeline, truck, rail, and marine logistics.

products.name: Convenience Retail Operations
products.description: Operation of company-owned and operated convenience retail facilities, primarily selling fuel and a range of merchandise. Requires physical retail locations, in-person labor, and compliance with local regulations.

products.name: Petroleum Product Distribution (Non-Fuel)
products.description: Distribution and sale of other petroleum products such as marine fuel, aviation fuel, propane, lubricating oil, and heating fuels to commercial, industrial, and governmental customers. Involves bulk procurement, storage, and delivery logistics.

products.name: Pipeline Transportation Services
products.description: Provision of transportation services for refined products, crude oil, and ammonia via an integrated network of pipelines. Includes storage and throughput services for third parties, requiring regulated infrastructure and compliance.

products.name: Terminal Storage and Transmix Processing Services
products.description: Operation of fuel terminals and transmix processing facilities, offering storage, blending, and separation services for refined products to support internal distribution and third-party customers. Requires specialized facilities and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Refined Product Manufacturing (Refinery Operations)
products.description: Manufacture of refined petroleum products (gasoline, diesel, jet fuel, etc.) at the Burnaby Refinery, including co-processing of bio feedstocks and blending of renewable fuels. Products are sold through retail, commercial, and airport channels.

products.name: Race Fuel Manufacturing and Sales
products.description: Manufacture and sale of specialized race fuels at a dedicated facility, distributed to motorsports customers. Involves physical production and distribution logistics.

products.name: Retail Grocery Products
products.description: Kroger operates supermarkets selling a wide range of consumer products, including fresh foods, center store items, and general merchandise, through physical stores and digital channels. Products are sourced from suppliers and produced in company-owned food production plants, then distributed to stores for sale to customers.

products.name: Retail Pharmacy Services
products.description: Kroger provides pharmacy services through in-store pharmacies at many supermarket locations, offering prescription medications and related health products to customers. These services require licensed pharmacists and compliance with healthcare regulations.

products.name: Fuel Sales
products.description: Kroger operates fuel centers at many supermarket locations, selling gasoline and diesel to customers. Fuel centers are physically co-located with stores and require regulated infrastructure for storage and dispensing.

products.name: eCommerce Grocery and General Merchandise
products.description: Kroger offers online ordering and fulfillment of groceries and general merchandise through Pickup, Delivery, and third-party platforms, supported by customer-facing apps and digital interfaces. Orders are fulfilled from stores, fulfillment centers, or via partners.

products.name: Private Label (Our Brands) Products
products.description: Kroger develops and sells a wide range of private label products under brands such as Private Selection®, Kroger®, Smart Way®, and Simple Truth®, produced in company-owned plants or by third-party manufacturers to Kroger's specifications.

products.name: Retail Media and Advertising Services
products.description: Through Kroger Precision Marketing, Kroger sells targeted advertising and media solutions to consumer-packaged goods companies and other partners, leveraging first-party customer data to deliver digital and in-store advertising campaigns.

products.name: Data Analytics Services
products.description: Kroger offers data analytics services to third parties, utilizing customer transaction and loyalty data to provide insights and value-added services, primarily through its data analytics subsidiary.

products.name: Commerce Intelligence Platform
products.description: A unified, AI-powered digital advertising platform that enables brands, agencies, retailers, and media owners to activate and monetize first-party commerce data, plan and buy media across channels, and deliver targeted, measurable ads throughout the shopper journey. Delivered as a cloud-based, self-service or managed service solution, integrating commerce data, media access, and predictive AI.

products.name: Performance Media Solutions
products.description: Outcome-based digital advertising services that enable brands and agencies to reach and convert consumers across the open internet, mobile, social, online video, and connected TV, using AI-driven targeting, campaign optimization, and closed-loop measurement. Delivered via managed-service (Commerce Growth) and self-service (GO) tools.

products.name: Retail Media Solutions
products.description: Advertising technology and services that allow retailers to monetize their digital properties by enabling brands and agencies to deliver personalized, product-level ads to shoppers on retailer sites (on-site) and across the open internet (off-site), with unified reporting and closed-loop sales attribution. Delivered as a self-service platform for both retailers and brands/agencies.

products.name: Supply Side Platform (Commerce Grid)
products.description: A commerce-focused supply side platform (SSP) that enables media owners and retailers to monetize their data and inventory programmatically, providing access to demand from brands and agencies and supporting programmatic retail media at scale. Delivered as a cloud-based technology solution.

products.name: Retail Media API Program
products.description: An API-based integration program that connects retailers, brands, and agencies to Criteo’s retail media technology, enabling third-party buying platforms and order management systems to access and activate retail media campaigns at scale.

products.name: Liquid Chromatography Systems and Consumables
products.description: Designs, manufactures, sells, and services high-performance and ultra-performance liquid chromatography (HPLC/UPLC) instruments, columns, and consumables, used for chemical analysis and purification in research, quality control, and industrial applications. These are physical instruments and consumables requiring manufacturing and regulated infrastructure.

products.name: Mass Spectrometry Systems
products.description: Develops, manufactures, sells, and services mass spectrometry (MS) instruments, often integrated with LC systems (LC-MS), for identification, quantification, and structural analysis of molecules in pharmaceutical, clinical, environmental, and industrial labs. These are complex physical instruments requiring advanced manufacturing and regulated infrastructure.

products.name: Thermal Analysis, Rheometry, and Calorimetry Instruments
products.description: Designs, manufactures, sells, and services instruments for thermal analysis, rheometry, and calorimetry, used to characterize material properties such as heat flow, viscosity, and stability in industries like pharmaceuticals, polymers, and electronics. These are physical instruments produced in specialized facilities.

products.name: Analytical Software Platforms
products.description: Develops and supplies advanced software products that interface with Waters and third-party instruments, enabling data acquisition, analysis, compliance, and laboratory workflow management. These are digital products delivered as installed or cloud-based software.

products.name: Instrument and Laboratory Services
products.description: Provides post-warranty service plans, support, maintenance, repair, validation, and customer training for Waters and TA instruments and software, including Software-as-a-Service offerings for instrument monitoring. Delivered through in-person human labor and digital platforms.

products.name: Biosciences and Diagnostic Solutions
products.description: Offers instruments and reagent systems for clinical diagnostics, including specimen collection and transport, detection of infectious diseases and cancers, immunology and cancer research solutions, flow cytometry instruments and reagents, and multiomics tools. These are regulated physical products and reagents for clinical and research labs.

products.name: Precision Chemistry Consumables and Reference Materials
products.description: Manufactures and sells precision chemistry consumables such as environmental and nutritional safety testing products, certified reference materials, and proficiency testing products for laboratory quality control and regulatory compliance. These are physical consumables produced in specialized facilities.

products.name: Deposit Services
products.description: Full-service deposit products including demand, money market, savings, and time deposits are offered through physical branches and digital channels, with FDIC insurance coverage. Delivery requires regulated banking infrastructure and branch/ATM network.

products.name: Residential Mortgage Lending
products.description: Origination and servicing of fixed-rate and adjustable-rate loans secured by single-family, owner-occupied residences, including home equity lines and loans. Loans are both retained and sold in the secondary market. Delivery requires regulated underwriting, collateral management, and compliance with mortgage regulations.

products.name: Commercial and Industrial Lending
products.description: Term loans and lines of credit to small and middle-market businesses and professionals, typically secured by business assets or real estate and requiring underwriting and collateral management. Delivered through relationship banking and regulated credit processes.

products.name: Commercial Real Estate Lending
products.description: Loans secured by commercial real estate properties, including multi-family, industrial, office, retail, healthcare, and hospitality assets. Delivery involves regulated underwriting, collateral evaluation, and ongoing risk management.

products.name: Construction and Land Development Lending
products.description: Loans for construction, land development, and other land loans for both residential and commercial projects. Delivery requires specialized underwriting, project monitoring, and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Consumer Lending
products.description: Unsecured and secured loans to consumers, including auto loans and other personal loans with relatively small average balances. Delivered through branch and digital channels, requiring consumer credit underwriting and compliance.

products.name: Cash Management Services
products.description: A suite of services for business customers to manage payments, collections, and liquidity, delivered through digital platforms and in-person support. Requires integration with core banking systems and secure digital infrastructure.

products.name: Digital Banking Services
products.description: Online and mobile banking platforms for consumers and businesses, enabling account access, transactions, and service requests. Delivery is digital-only, requiring secure IT infrastructure and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Fiduciary and Investment Management Services
products.description: Provision of fiduciary, trust, and investment management services to clients, delivered by licensed professionals and supported by regulated processes. Requires specialized expertise and compliance with investment regulations.

products.name: Office Property Leasing
products.description: Leasing of premier office properties to external tenants, primarily in major U.S. markets. Properties are owned, developed, and managed by the company, requiring significant physical real estate assets and ongoing property management services.

products.name: Life Science Property Leasing
products.description: Leasing of specialized life science properties to tenants in the biotechnology and healthcare sectors. These properties are developed and managed to accommodate laboratory and research uses, often requiring compliance with environmental and safety regulations.

products.name: Mixed-Use Property Leasing
products.description: Leasing of mixed-use properties that combine office, life science, retail, and/or residential spaces within a single development. These properties are developed and managed to serve multiple tenant types and uses.

products.name: Residential Property Leasing
products.description: Leasing of residential units within stabilized residential properties. These are managed as rental apartments and require ongoing property management and maintenance.

products.name: Roblox Platform (Immersive Experiences)
products.description: A digital platform that enables users to access, explore, and interact with millions of immersive, user-generated 3D and 4D experiences (including games, social spaces, and educational content) across mobile, desktop, and console devices. The platform is delivered digitally and relies on proprietary infrastructure, cloud services, and moderation systems.

products.name: Robux Virtual Currency
products.description: A proprietary digital currency sold directly to users for use within the Roblox Platform to purchase virtual items, avatar customizations, and in-experience enhancements. Robux is distributed digitally and monetized through one-time purchases and subscriptions.

products.name: Roblox Premium Subscription
products.description: A monthly subscription service that provides users with discounted Robux, access to exclusive in-experience benefits, and the ability to buy, sell, and trade certain avatar items. Delivered digitally via the Roblox Platform.

products.name: Avatar Items Marketplace
products.description: A digital marketplace where users can purchase, sell, and trade avatar items such as clothing, accessories, bodies, heads, and emotes, created by the community. Items are delivered digitally and accessed within the Roblox Platform.

products.name: Immersive Advertising Solutions
products.description: Programmatic ad units (such as immersive ads, rewarded video, billboards, and portals) that brands and creators can purchase to reach users within Roblox experiences. Delivered digitally and integrated natively into the platform's virtual environments.

products.name: Sponsored Experiences and Items
products.description: Paid promotional placements for experiences and avatar items, allowing creators and brands to increase discoverability within the Roblox Platform. Delivered digitally through the platform's search and recommendation systems.

products.name: Creator Tools and Plugins (Creator Store)
products.description: A digital store offering plugins, models, scripts, and other tools for creators to enhance their development workflows in Roblox Studio. These are sold by creators to other creators and delivered digitally.

products.name: IP Licensing Services
products.description: A service enabling rights holders to license their intellectual property to creators on the Roblox Platform, allowing monetization through earned Robux from branded content. Delivered digitally via the License Manager tool.

products.name: Marine Propulsion Systems
products.description: Designs, manufactures, and sells recreational marine engines and propulsion systems, including outboard, inboard, sterndrive, gas, diesel, and electric engines, as well as controls, rigging, and propellers. These are physically manufactured products distributed globally to boat builders, dealers, and retailers.

products.name: Recreational Boats
products.description: Manufactures and distributes a wide range of recreational boats under various brands, using physical manufacturing and a global dealer network. Boats incorporate engines and parts from other Brunswick segments.

products.name: Marine Parts and Accessories
products.description: Designs, manufactures, and distributes engine parts, consumables (oils, lubricants), electrical products, boat parts, and systems for marine and non-marine markets. Products are sold to aftermarket retailers, OEMs, and through Brunswick's own distribution businesses, requiring physical manufacturing and logistics infrastructure.

products.name: Marine Electronics and Connected Systems
products.description: Designs, develops, manufactures, and markets marine electronics, digital switching, electrification, and power components for recreational and commercial marine, RV, and specialty vehicle markets. Products include connected ecosystems and advanced digital solutions, delivered as physical and digital products to OEMs and aftermarket channels.

products.name: Boat Club Memberships and Shared-Access Services
products.description: Operates Freedom Boat Club, offering memberships that provide shared access to a fleet of boats at multiple locations. Delivered as a subscription service with physical access to boats and digital management via a mobile app.

products.name: Marine and Retail Financial Services
products.description: Provides secured wholesale inventory floor plan financing to boat and engine dealers and franchisees, as well as retail financing, extended service contracts, insurance, and digital retail finance solutions. Services are delivered through joint ventures and digital platforms.

products.name: Certified Pre-Owned Boat Platform
products.description: Operates Boateka, a platform for selling certified pre-owned boats, involving inspection, certification, and resale of used boats through a digital and physical channel.

products.name: Data Center Processors and Accelerators
products.description: High-performance CPUs (EPYC series), GPUs (Instinct series), AI accelerators, DPUs, AI NICs, FPGAs, and adaptive SoCs designed for data centers, manufactured using advanced semiconductor processes and delivered as chips or integrated boards for AI, cloud, and enterprise workloads.

products.name: Client Computing Processors
products.description: CPUs, APUs, and chipsets (Ryzen, Ryzen AI, Ryzen PRO, Threadripper, Athlon) for desktop and notebook PCs, manufactured as semiconductor chips and sold to OEMs and distributors for consumer, commercial, and enterprise computing.

products.name: Discrete and Professional Graphics Cards
products.description: Discrete GPUs (Radeon RX, Radeon PRO) for gaming, content creation, and professional workstations, manufactured as graphics cards and supported by proprietary software, sold to OEMs, distributors, and add-in-board partners.

products.name: Semi-Custom System-on-Chip (SoC) Solutions
products.description: Custom-designed SoCs integrating CPU, GPU, and multimedia technologies, co-developed with customers and manufactured for use in gaming consoles (e.g., Sony PlayStation, Microsoft Xbox) and handheld gaming devices.

products.name: Embedded Processors and Solutions
products.description: Embedded CPUs, APUs, FPGAs, adaptive SoCs, and SOMs (e.g., EPYC Embedded, Ryzen Embedded, Versal, Zynq, Kria) for industrial, automotive, healthcare, communications, and other specialized markets, delivered as chips or modules for integration into customer systems.

products.name: Networking and Data Center Connectivity Solutions
products.description: DPUs, AI NICs, and low-latency networking adapters (Pensando, Solarflare) with supporting software stacks, manufactured as hardware adapters and sold to data centers and cloud providers to accelerate networking and infrastructure services.

products.name: Development Boards, Kits, and Configuration Products
products.description: Development kits, boards, and starter kits (e.g., Kria SOMs, Alveo accelerator cards) including hardware, tools, and reference designs, sold to developers and OEMs to accelerate prototyping and deployment of applications on AMD platforms.

products.name: Software Development Platforms and Tools
products.description: Comprehensive software stacks, development tools, compilers, drivers, and AI software platforms (e.g., ROCm, Vitis, Vivado) enabling customers to develop, deploy, and optimize applications on AMD hardware, delivered digitally.

products.name: Intellectual Property (IP) Licensing
products.description: Licensing of portions of AMD's intellectual property portfolio, including patents and technology, to third parties for use in their own products or solutions.

products.name: Digital Marketing and Customer Acquisition Platform
products.description: A proprietary AI and machine learning-powered platform that acquires, analyzes, and monetizes user traffic across multiple digital channels and verticals, delivering high-intent customers to advertising partners. The platform operates at scale, integrating with major advertising networks and supporting various advertising formats including display, search, lead generation, video, e-commerce, and subscriptions.

products.name: Owned and Operated Consumer Websites
products.description: A portfolio of approximately 40 owned and operated websites, including search engines, digital media publishing sites, and web utilities/apps across categories such as shopping, travel, health, mapping, how-to, finance, business, technology, and automotive. These sites are monetized through advertising and data-driven content distribution.

products.name: Monetization Services for Network Partners
products.description: Services that monetize user traffic on behalf of third-party network partners by directing their acquired traffic through System1's platform in exchange for a share of advertising revenue generated, leveraging the company's technology and advertiser relationships.

firms.firm: Natural Grocers by Vitamin Cottage, Inc.

products.name: Natural and Organic Grocery Products
products.description: A comprehensive selection of natural and organic grocery items, including dry, frozen, canned groceries, bakery, beverages, and specialty diet products, sourced and sold through physical retail stores and online ordering. Products are manufactured or sourced from third-party suppliers and must meet strict quality guidelines prohibiting artificial ingredients and emphasizing organic certification.

products.name: USDA Certified Organic Produce
products.description: Fresh fruits and vegetables that are USDA certified organic, sourced from local and organic producers when feasible, and sold in-store. Selection varies seasonally and is distributed through the company's retail locations.

products.name: Dietary Supplements
products.description: A wide range of name-brand and private label dietary supplements, including vitamins, minerals, and specialty formulations, sold in-store and online. Products are sourced from third-party manufacturers and must comply with FDA regulations and the company's quality standards.

products.name: Natural Grocers Brand Private Label Products
products.description: A line of private label products under the Natural Grocers brand, including grocery staples, household products, bulk foods, and dietary supplements, produced by contract manufacturers and sold exclusively through company stores and online.

products.name: Bulk Foods
products.description: A selection of private label repackaged bulk products, such as dried fruits, nuts, grains, granolas, teas, herbs, and spices, packaged in a dedicated facility and sold in pre-packed sealed bags in stores.

products.name: Meats and Seafood
products.description: Humanely and sustainably sourced meat and seafood products, including frozen seafood and fresh/frozen meats, sourced from suppliers meeting strict animal welfare and sustainability standards, and sold in-store.

products.name: Dairy Products, Dairy Substitutes and Eggs
products.description: Natural and organic dairy products, non-dairy substitutes, and eggs, all sourced from pasture-raised, non-confinement livestock or free-range hens, and sold in-store. Includes milk, cheese, yogurt, and plant-based alternatives.

products.name: Prepared Foods
products.description: A selection of refrigerated, ready-to-eat fresh food items such as salads, sandwiches, salsa, hummus, and wraps, prepared and packaged for convenience and sold in-store. The offering size varies by location.

products.name: Body Care Products
products.description: A full range of cosmetics, skin care, hair care, fragrance, and personal care products containing natural and organic ingredients, sourced from third-party suppliers and sold in-store.

products.name: Pet Care Products
products.description: A line of natural pet care and food products that meet the company's human food product standards, sourced from third-party suppliers and sold in-store.

products.name: Household and General Merchandise
products.description: Sustainable, hypo-allergenic, and fragrance-free household products, including cleaning supplies, paper products, dish and laundry soap, and diapers, sourced from third-party suppliers and sold in-store.

products.name: Books and Educational Materials
products.description: Books and handouts on diet, lifestyle, health, and dietary supplements, stocked in-store and provided free of charge to customers. Includes approximately 200 book titles per store and hundreds of handouts.

products.name: Beer, Wine and Hard Cider
products.description: Craft beer, hard cider, and organic/biodynamic wine sold at select store locations, sourced from third-party suppliers and offered where permitted by law.

products.name: Online Ordering, Home Delivery and Pickup Services
products.description: Online ordering platform for grocery and dietary supplement products, with home delivery and in-store pickup services provided in partnership with a third party at most store locations.

products.name: BolaWrap Non-Lethal Restraint Devices
products.description: Handheld, non-lethal devices that deploy a Kevlar tether to entangle a subject's limbs, providing law enforcement and public safety officers with a proactive, non-pain compliance tool. Devices are physically manufactured, require proprietary consumable cassettes, and are distributed globally.

products.name: Wrap Reality Virtual Reality Training Platform
products.description: An immersive, scenario-based VR training platform for law enforcement and corrections, focused on human-factors awareness, decision making under stress, and use-of-force judgment. Delivered via proprietary software and hardware, with on-premises or cloud deployment options.

products.name: WrapTactics Digital Training Platform
products.description: A subscription-based digital training and performance platform delivering short-form, scenario-based instruction on non-lethal response tactics and decision-making. Delivered digitally, it supports recurring revenue through bundled training and service offerings.

products.name: WrapVision Body-Worn Cameras and Digital Evidence Management Platform
products.description: A body-worn camera solution assembled in North America, integrated with a cloud-based digital evidence management platform for video storage, retrieval, redaction, and sharing. Designed to meet federal procurement and data sovereignty requirements, and sold as both standalone and integrated solutions.

products.name: Counter-Unmanned Aircraft Systems (C-UAS) Solutions
products.description: Non-lethal drone interdiction systems leveraging proprietary tether deployment and modular cassette-based technology for defense, homeland security, and critical infrastructure protection. Includes the MERLIN program, with products in various stages of development and evaluation.

products.name: Professional Training and Managed Services
products.description: In-person and webinar-based training, instructor certification, policy support, and managed technology services for law enforcement and public safety agencies. Delivered by certified instructors and digital platforms, these services support product adoption and recurring revenue.

products.name: Create Solutions Platform
products.description: A comprehensive suite of software tools and services for building, shipping, and running real-time 2D and 3D content, including a custom 3D engine, AI-driven content creation, graphics, animation, audio, networking, and cloud-based asset management. Delivered digitally and used across gaming and various non-gaming industries.

products.name: Grow Solutions Platform
products.description: A suite of products and services for user acquisition, engagement, and monetization, including ad networks, mediation platform, offerwall, and analytics, supporting customers in scaling and monetizing their games and interactive content. Delivered digitally and integrated with mobile and other platforms.

products.name: Mobile Game Publishing Services (Supersonic)
products.description: A publishing solution for small studios and independent developers, providing expertise, tools, and support to launch and maximize the commercial success of mobile games. Delivered as a service combining digital tools and human expertise.

products.name: On-Device App Discovery and Engagement Platform (Aura)
products.description: A platform enabling app developers and telecom operators to connect with users via on-device app discovery, enhancing user engagement and monetization throughout the device lifecycle. Delivered through partnerships with device manufacturers and telecom operators.

products.name: Rail Products and Accessories
products.description: Manufactures and distributes new rail, trackwork, insulated rail joints, direct fixation fasteners, coverboards, power rail (third rail), and related accessories for freight and passenger railroads. Products are produced in-house or sourced and distributed globally.

products.name: Rail Friction Management Systems and Services
products.description: Engineers, manufactures, and services friction management products and application systems, including mobile and wayside systems that apply lubricants and friction modifiers to optimize rail-to-wheel performance. Includes aftermarket management services.

products.name: Rail Condition Monitoring and Digital Technology Solutions
products.description: Designs, engineers, and manufactures railroad condition monitoring systems (e.g., Total Track Monitoring, wheel impact load detection), wayside data collection, and digital communication/control solutions for rail and transit infrastructure. Includes contract services and digital signage.

products.name: Precast Concrete Buildings and Infrastructure Products
products.description: Manufactures precast concrete restrooms, concession stands, storage buildings, sound walls, bridge beams, and utility products for civil infrastructure, parks, and commercial markets. Products are produced at multiple US facilities under proprietary brands.

products.name: Steel Bridge Products
products.description: Designs, manufactures, and supplies fabricated steel and aluminum bridge products, including bridge railing and stay-in-place steel bridge forms, for highway, bridge, and transit infrastructure projects. Products are custom engineered and fabricated in-house.

products.name: Protective Pipe Coatings and Threading Services
products.description: Provides protective coatings (fusion bonded epoxy, abrasion resistant, internal linings) and threading services for steel pipe used in oil, gas, mining, waste-water pipelines, and water well applications. Services are performed at dedicated US facilities.

products.name: Industrial and Office Property Leasing
products.description: Ownership and leasing of primarily single-tenant industrial and office real estate properties to external tenants under long-term net leases, where tenants are responsible for most operating costs. Properties are acquired, owned, and managed by the company and are geographically diversified across the United States.

products.name: Real Estate Mortgage Financing
products.description: Provision of mortgage loans secured by commercial real estate properties, either as part of property acquisitions or as standalone investments, through a dedicated subsidiary. These loans are typically structured with the property as collateral and may be used by tenants or third parties.

products.name: Dog and Cat Supplies
products.description: Manufactured and marketed products for dogs and cats, including treats and chews, toys, beds, containment, grooming items, waste management, training pads, and supplements. These are produced in company-owned and contract manufacturing facilities and distributed through retail and eCommerce channels.

products.name: Small Animal, Bird, and Reptile Supplies
products.description: Products for small animals, pet birds, wild birds, and reptiles, including food, fortified diets, habitats, bedding, toys, enclosures, and accessories. These are manufactured in-house and distributed to retailers and specialty stores.

products.name: Animal Health and Insect Control Products
products.description: Health and wellness products for animals, including calming solutions, flea and tick controls, equine care (fly control, supplements, grooming, deworming, wound care), and insect control products for both professional and consumer use. These are manufactured using proprietary and regulated ingredients and distributed to retail, veterinary, and professional channels.

products.name: Aquatics and Reptile Products
products.description: Manufactured aquariums, terrariums, related fixtures, water conditioners, supplements, pumps, filters, lighting systems, and accessories for aquatic and reptile pets. Products are produced in company facilities and distributed through retail and specialty channels.

products.name: Live Fish and Small Animals
products.description: Wholesale distribution of live aquarium fish, plants, reptiles, and small animals to pet specialty, mass merchants, aquariums, and research institutions. Sourced and shipped through specialized logistics networks.

products.name: Outdoor Cushions
products.description: Manufactured and marketed outdoor cushions for residential use, sold under branded and private label lines, using proprietary and recycled fabrics. Products are produced in company facilities and distributed through major retailers both in-store and online.

products.name: Grass Seed Products
products.description: Production and sale of cool and warm season grass seed varieties and mixtures for residential, professional, forage, and wildlife use. Manufactured in advanced seed coating and conditioning facilities and distributed under proprietary and private label brands.

products.name: Wild Bird Products
products.description: Manufactured wild bird feed, bird houses, feeders, and accessories, including proprietary blends enhanced with vitamins and minerals. Produced in company facilities and distributed to retail and specialty channels.

products.name: Fertilizer and Lawn & Garden Controls
products.description: Production of fertilizers, soil supplements, and pest, weed, and insect control products in granular and liquid forms. Manufactured using commodity and specialty chemicals, and distributed under proprietary and private label brands to retail and professional markets.

products.name: Live Plants
products.description: Production and supply of live flowers, trees, shrubs, annuals, perennials, and indoor plants, primarily for large retail chains. Plants are grown in company-operated nurseries and shipped directly to stores.

products.name: Packet Seed Products
products.description: Manufactured and marketed packet seeds and seed starters for vegetables, herbs, and flowers, sold under multiple proprietary brands. Produced in company facilities and distributed through retail channels.

products.name: Wireless Technology Patent Licensing
products.description: Licensing of patented wireless communication technologies, including cellular (2G, 3G, 4G, 5G, 6G) and Wi-Fi standards, to manufacturers of smartphones, tablets, PCs, IoT devices, automobiles, and other connected consumer electronics. Delivered through patent license agreements, often on a fixed-fee or royalty basis, covering products compliant with industry standards.

products.name: Video Technology Patent Licensing
products.description: Licensing of patented video processing, encoding/decoding, and display technologies (including video codecs, HDR, immersive video, and AI-based video coding) to manufacturers of video-enabled devices and providers of video services. Delivered via patent license agreements to device makers (TVs, set-top boxes, streaming devices, etc.) and service providers (video streaming, conferencing, gaming).

products.name: IoT and Automotive Patent Licensing
products.description: Licensing of patented wireless and connectivity technologies essential for IoT devices and connected automobiles, including participation in joint licensing platforms (e.g., Avanci) that provide bundled licenses for cellular standards to IoT and automotive manufacturers. Delivered through direct and platform-based license agreements.

products.name: Cloud and Video Streaming Services Patent Licensing
products.description: Licensing of patented technologies used in cloud-based services, including video streaming, user-generated content sharing, video conferencing, and gaming platforms. Delivered via patent license agreements to service providers utilizing InterDigital’s video and wireless technologies in their offerings.

products.name: Expedited Less-Than-Truckload (LTL) and Truckload Transportation Services
products.description: Provides expedited regional, inter-regional, and national LTL and truckload freight transportation using an asset-light network, primarily in the continental United States, with some service in Canada and Mexico. Services are delivered through a mix of independent contractors, third-party carriers, and company-owned equipment, focusing on time-sensitive, high-value shipments.

products.name: Global Freight Forwarding Services (Air and Ocean)
products.description: Offers domestic and international freight forwarding services, including air and ocean transportation, primarily for time-sensitive and high-value freight. Services are delivered through partnerships with third-party transportation providers and company-employed drivers, with a focus on Asia to the United States and intra-Asia routes.

products.name: Contract Logistics and Supply Chain Management Solutions
products.description: Provides customized, asset-light logistics and supply chain management solutions, including warehousing, distribution, fulfillment, inventory management, cross docking, kitting, pick and pack, and value-added services. Solutions are tailored for high-growth end markets and delivered through a global network of service centers.

products.name: Intermodal Drayage and Container Services
products.description: Delivers first- and last-mile intermodal container drayage services to and from seaports and railheads, primarily in the Midwest and Southeast U.S. Also provides dedicated contract drayage, container freight station (CFS) warehousing, and handling services for air and ocean import/export freight.

products.name: Customs Brokerage and Trade Compliance Services
products.description: Provides customs brokerage and international trade compliance services to expedite cross-border shipments and ensure regulatory compliance. Services are integrated into broader logistics and forwarding offerings and delivered by licensed professionals.

products.name: Direct Lending Solutions
products.description: Provision of senior secured loans (including first lien and unitranche loans), second lien loans, and select junior capital positions to U.S. upper middle market companies, primarily backed by private equity sponsors. These are structured financial products requiring significant capital, underwriting, and regulatory compliance, and are delivered through direct origination and ongoing portfolio management.

products.name: Equity Co-Investments
products.description: Minority, non-control equity investments made alongside private equity sponsors in portfolio companies, typically structured as passive co-investments with minority rights and event-driven put rights. These investments are financial in nature and are delivered through negotiated transactions in conjunction with debt financings.

products.name: Small Business Investment Company (SBIC) Lending
products.description: Loans and equity investments provided to SBA-eligible small businesses through licensed SBIC subsidiaries, leveraging SBA-guaranteed debentures. These are regulated financial products requiring compliance with SBA regulations and are delivered via dedicated SBIC entities.

products.name: Net Lease Real Estate Investments
products.description: Acquisition and ownership of commercial real estate properties subject to triple net leases, primarily through a majority-owned REIT subsidiary. This involves physical real estate acquisition, management, and leasing to tenants under long-term contracts.

products.name: Retail and Commercial Banking Services
products.description: A full range of banking services including checking and savings accounts, certificates of deposit, debit and credit cards, and related services, delivered through physical branches, ATMs, and digital channels such as telephone, mobile, and internet banking.

products.name: Lending Services
products.description: A broad portfolio of loans including commercial, agricultural, commercial real estate, construction, residential real estate, home equity, and consumer loans, provided to individuals and small to mid-sized businesses, requiring in-person underwriting and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Wealth Management, Trust and Estate Services
products.description: Trust and estate administration, wealth management, and fiduciary services for individuals and businesses, delivered through specialized in-person and regulated trust operations.

products.name: Non-Deposit Investment Products
products.description: Investment products such as securities and mutual funds offered to the public through partnerships with third-party providers, requiring regulatory compliance but not involving deposit-taking.

products.name: Insurance Products
products.description: A range of insurance products sold to the public through agency partnerships, delivered via licensed agents and requiring regulatory compliance.

products.name: Other Banking Services
products.description: Ancillary banking services such as letters of credit, night depository, safe deposit boxes, utility payment services, and automatic funds transfer, provided through branch infrastructure and regulated processes.

products.name: Handbags
products.description: Handbags are designed and manufactured under the Coach and Kate Spade brands, including classically inspired and fashion designs, business cases, computer bags, messenger-style bags, backpacks, travel bags, and totes. These are produced through a global supply chain and sold via direct-to-consumer, wholesale, and licensing channels.

products.name: Accessories
products.description: Accessories include small leather goods (mini and micro handbags, money pieces, wristlets, pouches, cosmetic cases), novelty accessories, belts, key rings, technology accessories, gifting, straps, and charms. These are designed and produced for Coach and Kate Spade brands and distributed globally through retail, wholesale, and licensing.

products.name: Footwear
products.description: Footwear includes women's and men's shoes, boots, sneakers, and sandals, primarily under the Stuart Weitzman brand (and to a lesser extent Coach and Kate Spade). Products are manufactured by independent vendors and sold globally through direct-to-consumer and wholesale channels.

products.name: Lifestyle and Ready-to-Wear Products
products.description: This product line includes outerwear, ready-to-wear apparel, jewelry, home décor, and gifting items, designed and produced under the Coach and Kate Spade brands. These products are manufactured through a global supply chain and sold via retail and wholesale channels.

products.name: Licensed Products (Eyewear, Watches, Fragrance, Tech Accessories, Sleepwear, Bedding, Stationery)
products.description: Licensed products include eyewear, watches, fragrance, tech accessories, sleepwear, bedding, and stationery, designed in collaboration with licensing partners and sold under the Coach and Kate Spade brands. These products are produced by third-party licensees and distributed through retail, wholesale, and other approved channels.

products.name: Privacy-Enhancing Technologies and Infrastructure
products.description: Development, investment, and acquisition of privacy-enhancing technologies, including cryptographic protocols and privacy infrastructure, primarily focused on digital privacy for individuals and organizations. Delivered through digital platforms and strategic investments, not physical manufacturing.

products.name: Zcash Digital Asset Treasury Holdings
products.description: Acquisition and holding of Zcash (ZEC) digital assets as a treasury strategy, providing exposure to privacy-focused digital currency. This involves financial capital allocation and participation in the Zcash ecosystem, not physical product delivery.

products.name: Investment in Zcash Ecosystem Development
products.description: Strategic investment in companies and projects developing Zcash protocol and related wallet technologies, such as ZODL and the Zodl wallet, supporting the growth and usability of the Zcash network. Delivered through financial investments and partnerships.

products.name: Biomarker-Targeted Antibody Therapies for Cancer
products.description: Development of novel monoclonal antibody therapies targeting specific biomarkers (e.g., DKK1, GDF-15) for the treatment of cancer and related diseases. These are biologic drugs produced via biotechnological processes and delivered through regulated clinical and commercial channels.

products.name: MRO Distribution Products and Services
products.description: Distribution of maintenance, repair, and operations (MRO) products such as aftermarket automotive supplies, fastening systems, fluid power, electrical, specialty chemicals, cutting tools, abrasives, safety, and welding products, primarily through a network of sales representatives and distribution centers. Includes value-added services like vendor managed inventory (VMI), technical support, and on-site problem resolution. Products are sourced from thousands of suppliers and delivered to industrial, commercial, institutional, and governmental customers.

products.name: Electronic Test and Measurement Equipment and Production Supplies
products.description: Distribution of electronic test and measurement equipment, industrial and electronic production supplies, and related solutions. Includes design, rental, sale, calibration, refurbishment, and vendor managed inventory programs. Products are delivered through multiple brands and distribution centers, serving electronics manufacturing, aerospace, defense, and other industries.

products.name: Supply Chain Management and OEM Solutions
products.description: Provision of comprehensive supply chain management solutions for OEMs, including vendor managed inventory, kitting, global logistics management, manufacturing localization, value engineering, and quality assurance. Services are supported by a global network of service centers and tailored to mission-critical production line management and field installation programs.

products.name: Canadian Industrial and Contractor Supply Distribution
products.description: Wholesale distribution of industrial MRO supplies, safety products, fasteners, plumbing, tools, equipment, and related value-added services to industrial, government, commercial, and residential contractor markets in Canada. Products are sold through branch locations and warehouse shipments, with a focus on walk-up customers and local service.

products.name: Noninvasive Patient Monitoring Solutions
products.description: A suite of noninvasive monitoring technologies and devices, including pulse oximetry, rainbow Pulse CO-Oximetry, brain function monitoring, hemodynamic monitoring, regional oximetry, acoustic respiration rate monitoring, and capnography, delivered via bedside monitors, handheld devices, and wearable platforms. These products are manufactured in-house or via contract manufacturers and sold to hospitals, EMS, home care, and other healthcare providers.

products.name: Proprietary Sensors and Accessories
products.description: Single-patient-use (disposable) and reusable sensors, cables, cannulas, and accessories designed for use with Masimo monitoring platforms, manufactured to high standards and sold to healthcare providers for accurate patient data capture.

products.name: Patient Monitoring and Connectivity Platforms
products.description: Integrated hardware and software platforms (e.g., Root, Radius VSM, Masimo Hospital Automation Platform) that centralize patient monitoring, enable device interoperability, automate data transfer to EMRs, and support clinical workflows in hospitals. These platforms are manufactured and configured for hospital environments.

products.name: Hospital Automation and Connectivity Solutions
products.description: Software and hardware solutions (e.g., Patient SafetyNet, Iris, iSirona, Iris Gateway, UniView, Replica) that automate patient surveillance, enable device integration, and facilitate data transfer and clinician notification, improving workflow and patient safety. Delivered as integrated systems for hospital IT infrastructure.

products.name: OEM Circuit Boards and Modules
products.description: Embedded circuit boards and modules (e.g., MX-7, MSX-2040) that incorporate Masimo SET and rainbow technologies, sold to original equipment manufacturers (OEMs) for integration into their own multiparameter monitors and devices. These are manufactured in-house or by contract manufacturers.

products.name: Remote Patient Monitoring Solutions
products.description: Cloud-based platforms (e.g., Masimo SafetyNet) and associated devices that enable remote patient surveillance, spot-checking, and continuous monitoring outside the hospital, including home care. Delivered via disposable sensors, mobile applications, and secure cloud infrastructure.

products.name: Capnography and Gas Monitoring Solutions
products.description: Sidestream and mainstream capnography and gas monitoring devices and analyzers, available as external plug-in units, bedside and handheld devices, or integrated OEM offerings, for ventilation and gas monitoring across care settings. Manufactured and sold to healthcare providers and OEMs.

products.name: Minimally Invasive Hemodynamic Monitoring Solutions
products.description: Advanced hemodynamic monitoring systems (e.g., Masimo LidCO) that use existing arterial lines and proprietary algorithms to provide beat-to-beat monitoring in high-acuity care areas. Delivered as hardware and software platforms for operating rooms and critical care.

products.name: Modular Space Solutions
products.description: Prefabricated, relocatable modular units (including panelized/stackable offices, single-wide units, section modulars, classrooms, ground level offices, and blast-resistant modules) leased or sold to customers for temporary or permanent space needs. Units are manufactured offsite, delivered, installed, and maintained via a hybrid logistics network.

products.name: Portable Storage Solutions
products.description: Steel portable storage containers, including standard, climate-controlled, and refrigerated units, leased or sold for secure, on-site storage. Units are remanufactured, maintained, and delivered to customer locations, with customization options for security and access.

products.name: Clearspan Structures
products.description: Temporary and semi-permanent clearspan (fabric) structures, rapidly deployable and configurable for large-scale industrial, commercial, or event space needs. Delivered and installed on various surfaces, with options for lighting, climate, and graphics.

products.name: Value-Added Products (VAPS) for Modular and Storage Units
products.description: A portfolio of add-on products and services (e.g., workstations, furniture, appliances, media, power/solar, telematics, connectivity, security, entrance packages, lighting, organization, perimeter solutions, sanitation, and aesthetics) that enhance the functionality, comfort, and security of modular and storage units. Delivered and installed as part of turnkey solutions.

products.name: Sanitation Solutions
products.description: Rental and servicing of sanitation products, including built-in restrooms, premium restroom trailers, and related services for modular and portable units, provided directly or via third-party partners.

products.name: Delivery, Installation, and Removal Services
products.description: Logistics services for delivery, site work, installation, disassembly, and removal of modular space and storage units, provided as part of leasing or sales operations for an additional fee.

products.name: Technical and Project Management Services
products.description: Consulting and oversight services for building design, permitting, site preparation, and project management related to modular and storage unit deployment, offered as incremental value to customers.

products.name: Catheter-Based Sensing and Ablation System for Peripheral Nerve Disorders
products.description: A proprietary, catheter-delivered medical device platform that combines microchip-enabled sensing arrays and radiofrequency ablation to detect, target, and treat nerve-related disorders, initially focused on pain management for pancreatic cancer and with potential expansion to other visceral cancers, chronic pain, hypertension, and additional nerve-related conditions. The system is physically manufactured, involves disposable catheters, custom electronics, and software for real-time signal processing, and is delivered via minimally invasive vascular procedures in hospital settings.

products.name: Standalone Sensing Catheter System for Diagnostic Use
products.description: A disposable catheter-based device with proprietary microchip-enabled electrodes designed for high-sensitivity detection and mapping of neural signals within the peripheral nervous system, intended for diagnostic applications and to be used independently or in conjunction with other ablation systems. The device is physically manufactured and delivered for use in hospital catheter labs.

products.name: Custom Radiofrequency Ablation Catheter System
products.description: A catheter-based radiofrequency ablation device designed to deliver targeted energy to ablate problematic nerves within the peripheral nervous system, used for therapeutic intervention in pain management and other nerve-related disorders. The system is physically manufactured and intended for use in minimally invasive vascular procedures.

products.name: Cardlytics Commerce Media Platform
products.description: A digital advertising platform integrated within financial institutions' online and mobile banking channels, enabling marketers to deliver targeted offers and rewards to consumers based on anonymized purchase data. The platform is delivered through deep technological integrations with FI partners and leverages advanced analytics to optimize and measure marketing campaigns.

products.name: Bridg Customer Data Platform
products.description: A customer data platform that utilizes point-of-sale (POS) data from merchant partners to enable marketers to perform analytics, targeted loyalty marketing, and measure marketing impact. The platform builds anonymized customer profiles and supports marketing across various digital advertising channels.

products.name: Rippl Retail Media Solution
products.description: A retail media product offered through the Bridg platform, providing regional grocers, brands, and consumer packaged goods companies with capabilities to leverage customer data for targeted retail media advertising. It supports targeting and analytics for retail media campaigns.

products.name: Lift Trucks
products.description: Designs, manufactures, sells, and services a comprehensive line of internal combustion engine and electric lift trucks for material handling, produced in global manufacturing facilities and delivered through independent dealers and direct sales.

products.name: Lift Truck Attachments and Specialized Handling Equipment
products.description: Manufactures and sells precision-engineered attachments, forks, masts, lift tables, and specialized handling equipment for lift trucks, produced in dedicated facilities and marketed globally under multiple brands.

products.name: Lift Truck Parts
products.description: Provides a broad range of replacement and maintenance parts for Hyster, Yale, and competitor lift trucks, distributed through dealers and third-party wholesalers, with online ordering and technical support.

products.name: Fleet Management and Maintenance Services
products.description: Offers fleet management, full maintenance leases, and related services for lift trucks, delivered through dealer networks and direct programs, including rental and service contracts.

products.name: Energy Solutions for Lift Trucks
products.description: Develops and sells energy solutions including hydrogen fuel cells and lithium-ion battery technologies for industrial and commercial lift truck applications, integrated into new trucks or as retrofits.

products.name: Sulopenem Program (Oral and IV Formulations)
products.description: A portfolio of branded penem antibiotics, including ORLYNVAH™ (oral sulopenem etzadroxil-probenecid) and intravenous sulopenem, developed and manufactured through chemical synthesis and delivered as oral tablets or IV infusions for the treatment of drug-resistant gram-negative bacterial infections such as uncomplicated and complicated urinary tract infections (uUTI, cUTI), complicated intra-abdominal infections (cIAI), and potentially other serious infections. Products are produced via contract manufacturing organizations under cGMP conditions and distributed to healthcare providers for use in both community and hospital settings.

products.name: Nu.Q® Vet Cancer Test
products.description: A blood-based cancer screening test for dogs (and in development for cats), produced using proprietary nucleosome quantification technology. Delivered as a simple, cost-effective assay to veterinarians via distributors and diagnostic platforms, requiring physical manufacturing of assay kits and integration with automated or manual laboratory workflows.

products.name: Nu.Q® NETs Assay
products.description: A CE-marked blood test for detecting diseases associated with NETosis, such as sepsis, using proprietary biomarkers to quantify Neutrophil Extracellular Traps. Delivered as an analytically validated assay adaptable to central labs and point-of-care settings, requiring manufacturing of assay kits and platform integration.

products.name: Nu.Q® Cancer Assays
products.description: A family of blood-based assays for early detection, diagnosis, staging, and monitoring of cancer (with a focus on lung cancer), utilizing epigenetic analysis of nucleosomes. Delivered as cost-effective, non-invasive tests for clinical use, requiring manufacturing of assay kits and integration with laboratory workflows.

products.name: Capture-Seq™ / Capture-PCR™ Liquid Biopsy Tests
products.description: Blood-based liquid biopsy tests for early cancer detection, using proprietary methods to physically isolate and analyze tumor-derived circulating DNA fragments. Delivered as rapid, cost-effective assays suitable for automation in hospital laboratories, requiring specialized chemistry and kit manufacturing.

products.name: Nu.Q® Discover Research Services
products.description: A research service providing comprehensive nucleosome profiling and epigenetic biomarker assays for drug developers and scientists, supporting drug discovery, preclinical testing, and clinical studies. Delivered as a service leveraging proprietary assays and high-throughput models, requiring laboratory expertise and assay manufacturing.
